newsitem.title: SPAIN: FORECAST - Experts divided over next B/Spain cut.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Experts divided over next B/Spain cut.

text.p: The Bank of Spain could cut its official rate by 25 basis points to 5.00 pct at its next repurchase deal on Tuesday, June 24, but analysts' opinion are split almost down the middle.

A Reuter poll conducted on Friday of sixteen domestic and international financial experts, showed that nine favoured a rate cut, while the other seven were more convinced that the Spanish central bank would hold the rate.
All agreed the Spanish central bank has scope to cut the official rate now at 5.25 percent after the latest May CPI figures showed inflation at a record low of 1.5 percent.
But soms added that a cautious approach was likely because the economy was showing clear signs of recovery, and the risk now was for an overheating of economic growth.
The Bank of Spain started the current easing cycle on December 1995.
